summary.headline: HUDCO H1 FY27: disbursements above ₹35,000 cr (+37% YoY), loan book ₹1.86 lakh cr (+29%), spread guided ~2% and NIM ~3%.
summary.overview: Management reported strong H1 FY27 growth: disbursements above ₹35,000 cr (about 37% higher YoY), sanctions above ₹1 lakh cr, and loan book up 29% to ₹1.86 lakh cr. Revenue from operations rose 26% and net profit 31%. Asset quality improved, with gross NPA around 0.7% and net NPA 0.04%. Management guided to a spread of about 2% and NIM of about 3%, but acknowledged near-term pressure from rising borrowing costs, and said the spread would be maintained as resets flow through.

segments.name: Urban lending (sector agnostic)
segments.commentary: Housing, urban infrastructure, water (AMRUT), mobility, satellite/industrial towns and ring roads. Loan book target of ~₹2 lakh cr by FY27-end and ~₹3 lakh cr by 2030.

segments.name: PMAY
segments.commentary: PMAY-2 sanctions around ₹58,000 cr with ~₹48,000 cr released; ~20 lakh dwelling units sanctioned. Loans for state counterpart funding only where states opt in.

segments.name: PPP / private non-sovereign
segments.commentary: About ₹9,000 cr PPP sanctioned (Dharavi redevelopment, road, renewable, HAM). No PPP disbursement yet; Dharavi expected to start disbursing in the current quarter.

guidance_outlook: FY27 disbursement internal target ₹65,000 cr; ~₹30,000 cr remaining after H1 (~₹35,000 cr achieved).
FY27-end loan book target ~₹2 lakh cr; 2030 target ~₹3 lakh cr, set two years ago.
Spread to be about 2% at year-end; NIM target about 3%. Temporary slippage possible from resets and market moves.
Return on assets guided at 2% to 2.2%.
Expect negative credit costs (reversals) for a year or two; provision coverage ~95%.
Around 20,000 cr of loans to reset in H1; MCLR raised 15 bps, transmission expected to reflect in Q3. Shift to quarterly resets in some cases.
RBI swap window: ECB ~$2 bn raised at ~6.75% after hedging; further ~$1 bn targeted, disbursement before 31 Dec 2026.
Bond issuance paused as yields near ~8%; Q1 bond raise ~₹2,200 cr at ~7.25%; bank loans at ~7.25%.
capex_capacity: Sanctioned pipeline of ₹3 to 4 lakh cr with 3 to 5 year gestation, so conversion to disbursement will take time.
Plans to create ~1 lakh sq m of commercial space in the next three years for monetisation.
Setting up a strategic business group; repurposing and recruiting officers; regional offices for project monitoring.
demand_pricing: Urban challenge fund: ₹1 lakh cr central grant plus ₹1 lakh cr state contribution, aiming to unlock private capital.
Competitive pricing expected to hold; PPP lending priced with higher risk premium over state-government lending.
PPP lending restricted to investment-grade entities with strong concession agreements, third-party appraisal, PMA and TRA protections.

Recovery: H1 FY27 recovered ₹32 cr and resolved ₹359 cr; FY26 recovered ₹403 cr and resolved ₹660 cr; FY25 recovered ₹416 cr. Remaining stressed book about ₹1,200 cr, mostly NCLT and DRT cases; ~95% of loans are to private sector.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for yields and margins over the next one to two years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management targets ~2% spread and ~3% NIM, with temporary slippage possible from resets and borrowing costs. Spread ex-GoI loan (~₹20,000 cr at ~40 bps) is 1.96%, NIM 2.93%. The GoI loan rolls out in FY29.

qa_highlights.question: Disbursement target and whether it can be exceeded?
qa_highlights.answer: Internal FY27 target is ₹65,000 cr, with ~₹30,000 cr remaining after H1. Pace depends on project progress; management sees no reason to revise the target now.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the spread compression seen YoY and QoQ, and what supports 2% at year-end?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited the RBI swap window (~₹35,000 cr of borrowings at ~6.5-6.75%), a 15 bps MCLR hike, ~₹20,000 cr resetting in H1, and shifts to quarterly resets. Transmission effects and ECB impact expected in Q3.

qa_highlights.question: Will the other income help reach the 3% NIM target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the extra margin comes from return on equity. Monetisation of assets is also being pursued, but no figures were given.

qa_highlights.question: Upper-layer NBFC classification by RBI?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said compliance will be higher, including board approval for exposures above limits, but impact is limited given the loan book size and early compliance.

qa_highlights.question: Credit cost outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Negative credit costs expected for a year or two from resolutions and reversals, with provision coverage ~95%.

qa_highlights.question: Cost of borrowings by source?
qa_highlights.answer: ECB ~$2 bn at ~6.75% after hedging; bonds ~8% now (Q1 raise at ~7.25%); bank loans ~7.25%.

qa_highlights.question: Status of PMAY and the ₹3 lakh cr loan book guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: PMAY-2 sanctions ~₹58,000 cr, ~₹48,000 cr released, ~20 lakh units sanctioned. Management said loan book guidance was not revised; the target is ~₹2 lakh cr for this year.

risks_watch: Spread compression: rising borrowing costs, bond yields near 8%, and resets lagging; the 2% spread target depends on Q3 transmission of the 15 bps MCLR hike.
Execution on the ₹65,000 cr disbursement target; ~₹30,000 cr needed in H2.
PPP ramp-up: ~₹9,000 cr sanctioned but not disbursed; Dharavi disbursement expected this quarter.
Recovery of the stressed book (~₹1,200 cr), mostly NCLT and DRT cases, and the swap-window deadline of 31 Dec 2026.
Management's guidance has some inconsistencies (for example, the 3% NIM vs 2.93% reported, and the rationale for the 3 lakh cr target).
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, asset quality and funding measures, with repeated assurances on the 2% spread and 3% NIM. Answers on yield and spread were less precise, with an extended reference to the GoI loan and transmission timing. Management was evasive on the other income question and did not give figures on monetisation.
key_quotes: So I can assure you and the investor's fraternity that our spread will be around 2% and we will be maintaining on year to year basis.
Our gross NPA has declined to around 0.7% and net NPA is just above 0, that is 0.04%

adds.what: ~1 lakh sq m commercial space over next three years for monetisation

growth.why: Management held FY27 disbursement target of ₹65,000 cr (about ₹35,000 cr done in H1) and FY27-end loan book of ~₹2 lakh cr from a ₹1.86 lakh cr base, backed by sanctions of ~₹1 lakh cr per half and a ₹3-4 lakh cr sanctioned pipeline, though disbursement conversion takes 3-5 years and no company-owned capacity is quantified.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Spread at 1.96% ex-GoI loan and NIM 2.93% against a ~2% spread and ~3% NIM target, with cost of funds ~7.07% and ~20,000 cr resetting in H1, so near-term pressure rather than expansion.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No company-owned plant or line capacity is quantified; the only physical addition is ~1 lakh sq m of commercial space over three years for monetisation, which is minor, and the ₹3-4 lakh cr pipeline takes 3-5 years to convert.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 FY27 disbursements above ₹35,000 cr (+37% YoY) against a ₹65,000 cr FY27 target leave ~₹30,000 cr for H2, and the loan book grew 29% to ₹1.86 lakh cr with a ~₹2 lakh cr FY27-end target.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex or new capacity announcements were not discussed; the call covers lending disbursement, not company capex.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management said it sees no reason to revise the ₹65,000 cr disbursement target and held the loan book and spread guidance, with no raise signalled.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Spread slippage is acknowledged as possible from resets and market moves, and the 2% spread depends on Q3 MCLR transmission; ~₹30,000 cr of disbursement is needed in H2 and the PPP book has not yet disbursed.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new financial product or lending vertical launch was discussed beyond existing PPP and urban lending segments.

rows.label: Spread recovery via MCLR transmission in Q3
rows.why: A 15 bps MCLR hike and ~₹20,000 cr of H1 resets are expected to transmit in Q3, which is needed to hold the ~2% spread, but the timing is uncertain.

rows.label: Dharavi PPP disbursement start
rows.why: About ₹9,000 cr of PPP is sanctioned with no disbursement yet, and management expects Dharavi to start disbursing in the current quarter.

rows.label: Negative credit costs for a year or two
rows.why: Resolutions and reversals are expected to produce negative credit costs, with provision coverage at ~95% and gross NPA ~0.7%, net NPA 0.04%.

tone.note: Management was confident on disbursement growth, asset quality and funding, and repeated the 2% spread and 3% NIM targets; it was less precise on yield and spread transmission and evasive on other income and monetisation, while analysts pushed on spread compression and the 3 lakh cr loan book target
